Functioning as an intermediary between Mutual Funds and Portfolio Management Services, SIFs accommodate various investment approaches. Their asset management has soared beyond ₹38,000 crore, signaling robust expansion since inception. Investors can opt for equity, bond, or hybrid SIFs to align with their risk tolerance.

banking-economy.title: RBI cancels registrations of 49 NBFCs; 13 NBFCs and one HFC surrender licenses
banking-economy.summary: The Reserve Bank of India has revoked the registrations of 49 non-banking financial companies. Additionally, 13 companies, alongside a housing finance firm, voluntarily surrendered their registrations. This action reflects the RBI's commitment to maintaining oversight on financial institutions. Companies classified as unregistered Type I NBFCs or that halted operations will no longer participate in non-banking financial services.

banking-economy.title: Mufin Green Finance gets RBI licence to offer forex, remittance services
banking-economy.summary: Mufin Green Finance has recently received an AD-II licence from the RBI, permitting it to offer forex services. This new licence enables the company to provide remittance services for medical treatments, education, and family maintenance. Mufin anticipates diversifying revenue streams through these fee-based services, reducing reliance on net interest income. The company's recent financial results indicate significant growth in profit and income.
